name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Houthi missile aimed at Madinah condemned by Gulf states; Israeli strikes kill four in Gaza
state: A Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Madinah drew condemnation from Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Jordan, and Israeli attacks killed four Palestinians in Gaza despite the ceasefire, Anadolu reported on 6 Nov. An Israeli strike killed a man in south Lebanon on 4 Nov, Lebanon's health ministry said. The US–Iran war continues, with Iran saying it downed two US drones on 5 Nov. Several fronts are active at once.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Israel, Lebanon, Yemen and the Gulf; flight disruption across the region can occur at short notice.
